title: The comment-narration check scans shell files
why: lint/check_comment_narration.py does not scan shell files, so a history comment such as hooks/session_start.sh:24's "(incident 2026-11-07, /base_run.txt)" passes lint (lane notes-fix-guard-2; coordinator, 01:18 CST Nov 8). Rule building-comments-say-why.
note: Fix: scan *.sh (and other shell files the repo ships) with a shell-aware comment reader that respects strings and heredocs (rule building-scanner-respects-strings); red case first on the session_start.sh line, and a control where a why-comment passes. Related done steps: comment-narration-patterns, comment-check-local-entry. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 01:20 CST Nov 8. #1517 (TMPDIR, 1d42dae42) is with runner 8 and its lane builds a small follow-up (coordinator).
